"""Remove only receipted new QA identities/private objects while the game is stopped."""

import hashlib
import json
import socket
import sys


def port_open(port):
    """Require the exact stopped instance before removing its temporary fixtures."""
    with socket.socket() as probe:
        probe.settimeout(1)
        return probe.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0


def remove_qa(plan, players, world):
    """Collector proof and all-table comparison refuse any non-QA cascade/write."""
    from django.apps import apps
    from django.db import connection, transaction
    from django.db.models import Q
    from django.db.models.deletion import Collector
    from evennia.accounts.models import AccountDB
    from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
    from evennia.typeclasses.models import Attribute, Tag
    from pokemon.models.breeding import BreedingCycle, BreedingEgg
    from pokemon.models.core import OwnedPokemon
    from pokemon.models.daycare import DaycareEntry
    from pokemon.models.market import MarketListing
    from pokemon.models.necrozma import NecrozmaCombination
    from pokemon.models.onboarding import OnboardingCompletion
    from pokemon.models.ownership import OwnershipTransfer, PokemonReservation
    from pokemon.models.storage import PokemonPlacement

    tag = plan["tagged_qa"]["tag"]
    names = plan["tagged_qa"]["ordinary_player_names"]
    assert players["tag"] == world["tag"] == tag
    assert [row["name"] for row in players["players"]] == names
    actorids = {row["player"] for row in players["players"]}
    accountids = {row["account"] for row in players["players"]}
    privateids = actorids | {row["id"] for row in world["objects"]}
    assert len(actorids) == len(accountids) == 4

    with transaction.atomic():
        list(ObjectDB.objects.select_for_update().filter(pk__in=privateids).order_by("pk"))
        for row in players["players"]:
            actor = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=row["player"], db_key=row["name"], db_tags__db_key=tag)
            account = AccountDB.objects.get(pk=row["account"], username=row["name"], db_tags__db_key=tag)
            # Ordinary unpuppet/logout clears the transient active account FK.
            assert ObjectDB.objects.filter(pk=actor.pk).values_list("db_account_id", flat=True).get() is None
            account_state = AccountDB.objects.filter(pk=account.pk).values("db_is_connected", "is_superuser").get()
            assert not account_state["db_is_connected"] and not account_state["is_superuser"]
            assert [value.pk for value in (account.attributes.get("_playable_characters") or [])] == [actor.pk]
            for other in AccountDB.objects.exclude(pk=account.pk):
                assert actor.pk not in [value.pk for value in (other.attributes.get("_playable_characters") or [])]
            assert not account.db_is_connected and not actor.db.battle_id and not actor.db.battle_lock
            assert not actor.contents
        assert set(ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_tags__db_key=tag).values_list("pk", flat=True)) == privateids
        assert set(AccountDB.objects.filter(db_tags__db_key=tag).values_list("pk", flat=True)) == accountids
        assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_account_id__in=accountids).exclude(pk__in=actorids).exists()
        for row in world["objects"]:
            obj = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=row["id"], db_key=row["key"])
            assert obj.db_typeclass_path == row["typeclass"]
            assert obj.db_location_id == row["location"] and obj.db_destination_id == row["destination"]
            assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(Q(db_location_id=obj.pk) | Q(db_destination_id=obj.pk) | Q(db_home_id=obj.pk)).exclude(pk__in=privateids).exists()
        owned = OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(trainer__user_id__in=actorids)
        ownedids = set(owned.values_list("pk", flat=True))
        assert not NecrozmaCombination.objects.filter(Q(host_id__in=ownedids) | Q(companion_id__in=ownedids)).exists()
        assert not PokemonReservation.objects.filter(pokemon_id__in=ownedids).exists()
        # A normal permanent onboarding form remains reserved after +unfuse.
        # Accept only inactive, fully consistent forms on these exact four QA owners.
        from pokemon.services.fusion_transitions import FusionTransitions
        forms = set()
        for identifier in actorids:
            actor = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=identifier)
            state = FusionTransitions(actor).inspect()
            assert state["active"] is None and not state["problems"]
            current = set(state["forms"])
            assert not (forms & current)
            assert set(map(str, OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(trainer__user_id=identifier, pk__in=current).values_list("pk", flat=True))) == current
            forms.update(current)
        assert set(map(str, PokemonPlacement.objects.filter(pokemon_id__in=ownedids, location_type="fusion").values_list("pokemon_id", flat=True))) == forms
        assert not PokemonPlacement.objects.filter(pokemon_id__in=ownedids).exclude(location_type__in=("party", "box", "fusion")).exists()
        assert not DaycareEntry.objects.filter(storage__user_id__in=actorids, state="active").exists()
        assert not owned.exclude(held_item="").exclude(held_item__isnull=True).exists()
        cycles = BreedingCycle.objects.filter(origin_character_id__in=actorids)
        assert not cycles.filter(state="producing").exists()
        eggs = BreedingEgg.objects.filter(cycle__in=cycles)
        assert not eggs.exclude(pokemon_id__in=ownedids).exclude(pokemon__isnull=True).exists()
        listings = MarketListing.objects.filter(seller_character_id__in=actorids)
        assert not listings.filter(state="active").exists()
        assert not listings.exclude(buyer_character_id__in=actorids).exclude(buyer_character_id__isnull=True).exists()
        transfers = OwnershipTransfer.objects.filter(Q(proposer_id__in=actorids) | Q(recipient_id__in=actorids))
        assert not transfers.exclude(proposer_id__in=actorids).exists()
        assert not transfers.exclude(recipient_id__in=actorids).exists()
        assert not transfers.filter(state="pending").exists()
        onboarding = OnboardingCompletion.objects.filter(origin_character_id__in=actorids)
        assert onboarding.count() == 4
        objects = list(ObjectDB.objects.filter(pk__in=privateids))
        accounts = list(AccountDB.objects.filter(pk__in=accountids))
        tags = list(Tag.objects.filter(db_key=tag))
        attrids = {attr.pk for obj in objects + accounts for attr in obj.db_attributes.all()}
        models = [model for model in apps.get_models(include_auto_created=True)
                  if model._meta.managed and not model._meta.proxy]

        def snapshot():
            """Keep full private row values only in memory for this atomic comparison."""
            return {model._meta.db_table: (model._meta.pk.attname,
                    list(model._base_manager.order_by("pk").values())) for model in models}

        all_before = snapshot()
        # Immutable terminal receipts survive normal source/character deletion.
        # Only their actual nullable FK links into this exact QA deletion set may clear.
        storageids = set(owned.values_list("trainer__user__userstorage__pk", flat=True))
        daycareids = set(DaycareEntry.objects.filter(storage__user_id__in=actorids).values_list("pk", flat=True))
        retained = {}
        for queryset, fields, domains in (
            (cycles, ("storage_id", "parent_a_id", "parent_b_id"), (storageids, daycareids, daycareids)),
            (eggs, ("pokemon_id",), (ownedids,)),
            (listings, ("seller_id", "buyer_id", "pokemon_id"), (actorids, actorids, ownedids)),
            (onboarding, ("character_id", "pokemon_id"), (actorids, ownedids)),
        ):
            table = queryset.model._meta.db_table
            rows = {}
            for row in queryset.values():
                allowed = {}
                for field, domain in zip(fields, domains):
                    value = row[field]
                    assert value is None or value in domain, ("Foreign retained receipt link", table, field)
                    if value is not None:
                        allowed[field] = value
                rows[str(row[queryset.model._meta.pk.attname])] = allowed
            retained[table] = rows
        manual = {}
        collector = Collector(using="default")
        collector.collect(list(owned))
        collector.collect(objects)
        collector.collect(accounts)
        collector.collect(tags)

        def deletions():
            """Resolve exact affected model PKs, including automatic relation tables."""
            result = {table: set(ids) for table, ids in manual.items()}
            for model, rows in list(collector.data.items()) + [(qs.model, qs) for qs in collector.fast_deletes]:
                result.setdefault(model._meta.db_table, set()).update(row.pk for row in rows)
            return result

        planned = deletions()
        for table, rows in retained.items():
            assert not (set(rows) & {str(value) for value in planned.get(table, set())})
        # Delete only attributes whose every FK link is already in the QA deletion set.
        removable = []
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            refs = []
            for table in connection.introspection.table_names(cursor):
                constraints = connection.introspection.get_constraints(cursor, table)
                pkcols = next((value["columns"] for value in constraints.values() if value.get("primary_key")), [])
                for value in constraints.values():
                    if value.get("foreign_key") == ("typeclasses_attribute", "id"):
                        assert len(pkcols) == 1
                        refs.append((table, value["columns"][0], pkcols[0]))
            for identifier in attrids:
                safe = True
                for table, column, pkcol in refs:
                    quote = connection.ops.quote_name
                    cursor.execute("SELECT " + quote(pkcol) + " FROM " + quote(table) + " WHERE " + quote(column) + "=%s", [identifier])
                    if not {row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()} <= planned.get(table, set()):
                        safe = False
                        break
                if safe:
                    removable.append(identifier)
        collector.collect(list(Attribute.objects.filter(pk__in=removable)))
        planned = deletions()
        assert planned.get("objects_objectdb", set()) <= privateids
        assert planned.get("accounts_accountdb", set()) <= accountids
        assert planned.get("pokemon_ownedpokemon", set()) <= ownedids

        def protected(data):
            """Every row outside the exact deletion set must retain all its fields."""
            result = {}
            for table, (pk, rows) in data.items():
                excluded = {str(value) for value in planned.get(table, set())}
                kept = []
                for row in rows:
                    if str(row[pk]) in excluded:
                        continue
                    normalized = dict(row)
                    for field, old in retained.get(table, {}).get(str(row[pk]), {}).items():
                        assert normalized[field] in (old, None)
                        normalized[field] = None
                    kept.append(normalized)
                result[table] = kept
            return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()

        before = protected(all_before)
        collector.delete()
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE")
        all_after = snapshot()
        for table, rows in retained.items():
            pk, values = all_after[table]
            current = {str(row[pk]): row for row in values}
            assert set(rows) <= set(current)
            for identifier, fields in rows.items():
                assert all(current[identifier][field] is None for field in fields)
        after = protected(all_after)
        assert after == before
        assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(pk__in=privateids).exists()
        assert not AccountDB.objects.filter(pk__in=accountids).exists()
        assert not OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(pk__in=ownedids).exists()
        assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_tags__db_key=tag).exists()
        result = dict(removed_accounts=sorted(accountids), removed_objects=sorted(privateids),
                      removed_pokemon=sorted(map(str, ownedids)), protected_digest_before=before,
                      protected_digest_after=after, all_other_rows_unchanged=True,
                      retained_receipts={table: sorted(rows) for table, rows in retained.items()},
                      permitted_nullable_links_cleared_only=True, refunds=False, refill=False, public_sources_removed=False)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from atomic_upgrade import authorize, TASK, CANDIDATE

    assert sys.argv[1:] == ["--cleanup-approved"]
    authorize()
    supplement = json.loads((TASK / "retained-cleanup-approval.json").read_text())
    assert supplement["approved"] is True and supplement["candidate"] == CANDIDATE
    assert supplement["scope"] == "exact tagged QA cleanup retaining sealed receipts and one guarded maintenance cycle"
    from pathlib import Path
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == supplement["controller_sha256"]
    import evennia

    evennia._init()
    assert all(not port_open(port) for port in (4000, 4001, 4002, 4005, 4006))
    plan = json.loads((TASK / "reviewed-plan.json").read_text())
    players = json.loads((TASK / "qa-player-prerequisites.json").read_text())
    world = json.loads((TASK / "qa-world-receipt.json").read_text())
    result = remove_qa(plan, players, world)
    result["candidate"] = CANDIDATE
    with (TASK / "qa-cleanup-receipt.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("TAGGED_QA_REMOVED", CANDIDATE, "all other rows and public stock preserved")

"""Install published integrity DDL only in this test's random disposable schema."""
import hashlib
import importlib
from django.db import connection

def guard_sql():
    """Use repository definitions; no migration executor or live-server export."""
    names=['0041_placement_integrity_triggers','0048_ownership_integrity','0050_market_integrity',
           '0052_daycare_integrity','0054_breeding_integrity','0058_necrozma_integrity']
    modules=[importlib.import_module('pokemon.migrations.'+name) for name in names]
    statements=[modules[0].CHECK_SQL,modules[1].SQL,modules[2].NEW_SEAL+modules[2].SQL,
                modules[3].NEW_CHECK+modules[3].SQL,modules[4].SQL,modules[5].SQL]
    native=modules[-1]
    for index,table in enumerate(native.FROZEN_TABLES):
        statements.append(f'CREATE TRIGGER pf2_necrozma_freeze_{index} BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON pokemon_{table} FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION pf2_necrozma_source_freeze();')
    for index,table in enumerate(native.TABLES):
        statements.append(f'CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER pf2_necrozma_{index} AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON pokemon_{table} DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION pf2_necrozma_guard();')
    return statements

def install():
    """Add actual published guards after separately prepared valid local fixtures."""
    statements=guard_sql()
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute('SELECT current_schema()')
        assert cursor.fetchone()[0].startswith('pf2_recovery_test_')
        for statement in statements:cursor.execute(statement)
        cursor.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=current_schema() AND NOT t.tgisinternal")
        count=cursor.fetchone()[0]
    return dict(ddl_sha256=hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(statements).encode()).hexdigest(),noninternal_triggers=count,migration_executor_used=False,live_catalog_export=False)

def remove():
    """Remove only this disposable schema's fixture guard functions after a test."""
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute('SELECT current_schema()');schema=cursor.fetchone()[0]
        assert schema.startswith('pf2_recovery_test_')
        cursor.execute("SELECT p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=%s AND p.proname LIKE 'pf2_%%'",[schema])
        rows=cursor.fetchall()
        quote=connection.ops.quote_name
        for name,args in rows:
            cursor.execute('DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS '+quote(schema)+'.'+quote(name)+'('+args+') CASCADE')

"""Rehearse exact QA cleanup against only a fresh local disposable schema."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest
from uuid import uuid4

ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = ART.parents[1]
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT / "tests/integration")]
fixture = json.loads(Path(r"H:\PokemonFusionProject\fusion2\.codex-artifacts\necrozma-20261024\postgres-fixture.json").read_text())
assert not fixture["stopped"]
os.environ["PF2_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN"] = fixture["dsn"]
from isolated_postgres import IsolatedPostgres
import item_availability_cases as acquisition

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("reviewed_cleanup", ART / "cleanup_retained_template.py")
cleanup = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(cleanup)
observations = []


class CleanupCases(unittest.TestCase):
    """Source/owned fixtures are setup only; this tests guarded deletion, not gameplay."""

    native = acquisition.AcquisitionCases.native

    def setUp(self):
        acquisition.AcquisitionCases.setUp(self)
        suffix = uuid4().hex
        self.tag = "cleanup-fixture-" + suffix
        names = ["ItemCleanup" + str(i) + suffix[:6] for i in range(4)]
        self.plan = {"tagged_qa": {"tag": self.tag, "ordinary_player_names": names}}
        people = []
        self.owned = []
        for name in names:
            account = AccountDB.objects.create(username=name, db_key=name)
            actor = ObjectDB.objects.create(db_key=name, db_account=account, db_typeclass_path="pokemon.user.User")
            account.attributes.add("_playable_characters", [actor])
            actor.db_account = None
            actor.save(update_fields=["db_account"])
            account.tags.add(self.tag)
            actor.tags.add(self.tag)
            highest = Trainer.objects.order_by("-trainer_number").values_list("trainer_number", flat=True).first() or 0
            trainer, _ = Trainer.objects.get_or_create(user=actor, defaults={"trainer_number": highest + 1})
            storage, _ = UserStorage.objects.get_or_create(user=actor)
            mon = create_owned_pokemon("Eevee", trainer, 50, nature="Hardy", ability="Run Away",
                                       gender="M", ivs=[0]*6, evs=[0]*6, active_move_names=["Tackle"])
            PlacementService(storage).to_party(mon, 3)
            self.owned.append(mon)
            OnboardingCompletion.objects.create(character=actor, origin_character_id=actor.pk,
                pokemon=mon, pokemon_uuid=mon.pk, kind="human")
            people.append(dict(name=name, player=actor.pk, account=account.pk, trainer=trainer.pk))
        self.people = {"tag": self.tag, "players": people}
        room = create_object("typeclasses.rooms.Room", key="cleanup-private-center-" + suffix, nohome=True)
        room.tags.add(self.tag)
        self.private_room = room
        self.world = {"tag": self.tag, "objects": [dict(id=room.pk, key=room.key,
            typeclass=room.db_typeclass_path, location=room.db_location_id, destination=room.db_destination_id)]}
        # A closed receipt with nullable parent links exercises PROTECT ordering.
        mother = create_owned_pokemon("Eevee", self.owned[0].trainer, 50, nature="Hardy", ability="Run Away",
            gender="F", ivs=[0]*6, evs=[0]*6, active_move_names=["Tackle"])
        storage = UserStorage.objects.get(user_id=people[0]["player"])
        PlacementService(storage).to_party(mother, 4)
        egg = create_owned_pokemon("Eevee", self.owned[0].trainer, 1, nature="Hardy", ability="Run Away",
            gender="M", ivs=[0]*6, evs=[0]*6, active_move_names=["Tackle"])
        PlacementService(storage).to_party(egg, 5)
        now = timezone.now()
        cycle = BreedingCycle.objects.create(storage=storage, origin_character_id=people[0]["player"],
            parent_a_uuid=self.owned[0].pk, parent_b_uuid=mother.pk, egg_uuid=egg.pk, state="collected",
            plan={"rule_version":"1", "is_shiny":False}, started_at=now, ready_at=now, next_ready_at=now, closed_at=now)
        BreedingEgg.objects.create(id=egg.pk, cycle=cycle, pokemon=egg, collected_at=now,
                                  hatch_ready_at=now, hatched_at=now, hatch_owner_id=people[0]["player"])


        first=DaycareEntry.objects.create(storage=storage,pokemon=self.owned[0],owned_id=self.owned[0].pk,saved_name="QA father",
            state="retrieved",place=1,retrieved_at=now)
        second=DaycareEntry.objects.create(storage=storage,pokemon=mother,owned_id=mother.pk,saved_name="QA mother",
            state="retrieved",place=2,retrieved_at=now)
        BreedingCycle.objects.filter(pk=cycle.pk).update(parent_a=first,parent_b=second)
        identifier=uuid4();purchase=uuid4()
        self.market=MarketListing.objects.create(id=identifier,seller_id=people[0]["player"],seller_character_id=people[0]["player"],
            seller_name=people[0]["name"],pokemon=self.owned[0],owned_id=self.owned[0].pk,request_selector=str(self.owned[0].pk),
            snapshot={},price=100,state="sold",created_at=now,expires_at=now,closed_at=now,buyer_id=people[1]["player"],
            buyer_character_id=people[1]["player"],purchase_id=purchase,
            receipt=dict(purchase=str(purchase),listing=str(identifier),buyer=str(people[1]["player"]),seller=str(people[0]["player"]),price="100"))
        if self._testMethodName=="test_foreign_retained_receipt_link_refuses_without_write":
            MarketListing.objects.filter(pk=self.market.pk).update(pokemon=self.mon)
        import fixture_integrity
        self.addCleanup(fixture_integrity.remove)
        self.guard_receipt=fixture_integrity.install()

    def tearDown(self):
        import fixture_integrity
        fixture_integrity.remove()
        acquisition.AcquisitionCases.tearDown(self)

    def test_exact_cleanup_preserves_existing_people_and_public_stock(self):
        before_stock = BattleRewards.stored_attribute(public_shop, "store_inventory")
        original_ids = [player.pk for player in self.players]
        result = cleanup.remove_qa(self.plan, self.people, self.world)
        self.assertTrue(result["all_other_rows_unchanged"])
        self.assertEqual(result["protected_digest_before"], result["protected_digest_after"])
        self.assertEqual(ObjectDB.objects.filter(pk__in=original_ids).count(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(BattleRewards.stored_attribute(public_shop, "store_inventory"), before_stock)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["removed_pokemon"]), 6)
        observations.append(dict(case=self._testMethodName, receipt=result, preexisting_source_and_actors_preserved=True))

    def test_unreviewed_occupant_refuses_before_any_cleanup(self):
        foreign = create_object("typeclasses.objects.Object", key="non-QA-occupant-" + uuid4().hex,
                                location=self.private_room, nohome=True)
        before = set(ObjectDB.objects.values_list("pk", flat=True))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            cleanup.remove_qa(self.plan, self.people, self.world)
        self.assertEqual(set(ObjectDB.objects.values_list("pk", flat=True)), before)
        foreign.delete()
        result = cleanup.remove_qa(self.plan, self.people, self.world)
        observations.append(dict(case=self._testMethodName, refused_before_write=True,
                                 subsequent_exact_cleanup=result["all_other_rows_unchanged"]))

    def test_active_fusion_refuses_then_ordinary_unfuse_allows_exact_cleanup(self):
        from pokemon.services.fusion_transitions import FusionTransitions
        from utils.fusion import deactivate_fusion
        actor = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=self.people["players"][2]["player"])
        source = self.owned[2]
        PlacementService(actor.storage).reserve_for_fusion(source)
        actor.db.fusion_forms = [str(source.pk)]
        actor.db.fusion_id = str(source.pk)
        actor.db.fusion_kind = "permanent"
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            cleanup.remove_qa(self.plan, self.people, self.world)
        self.assertTrue(OwnedPokemon.objects.filter(pk=source.pk).exists())
        ok, _ = deactivate_fusion(actor)
        self.assertTrue(ok)
        state = FusionTransitions(actor).inspect()
        self.assertIsNone(state["active"])
        self.assertEqual(state["forms"], [str(source.pk)])
        result = cleanup.remove_qa(self.plan, self.people, self.world)
        self.assertTrue(result["all_other_rows_unchanged"])
        observations.append(dict(case=self._testMethodName, active_refused=True,
            ordinary_unfuse=True, inactive_owned_form_removed=True, other_rows_unchanged=True))

    def test_foreign_form_refuses_without_removing_any_rows(self):
        actor = ObjectDB.objects.get(pk=self.people["players"][2]["player"])
        actor.db.fusion_forms = [str(self.mon.pk)]
        objects = set(ObjectDB.objects.values_list("pk", flat=True))
        pokemon = set(OwnedPokemon.objects.values_list("pk", flat=True))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            cleanup.remove_qa(self.plan, self.people, self.world)
        self.assertEqual(set(ObjectDB.objects.values_list("pk", flat=True)), objects)
        self.assertEqual(set(OwnedPokemon.objects.values_list("pk", flat=True)), pokemon)
        observations.append(dict(case=self._testMethodName, foreign_form_refused=True,
            all_objects_and_owned_rows_preserved=True))


    def assert_refusal_preserves_all_rows(self):
        from django.apps import apps
